description: This source file defines a builder class for creating `MedicationDispense` objects in the OpenMRS system. It provides methods to set various properties of a medication dispense, such as patient, drug, encounter, status, and dates, facilitating easy and flexible construction of test objects.

classes.name: MedicationDispenseBuilder
classes.description: A builder class to facilitate creation and configuration of MedicationDispense objects for testing or setup purposes within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: withUuid
methods.description: Sets the UUID for the MedicationDispense.

methods.name: withPatient
methods.description: Associates a Patient with the MedicationDispense using a patient ID.

methods.name: withConcept
methods.description: Sets the concept representing the medication or status using a concept ID.

methods.name: withStatus
methods.description: Sets the status and status reason concepts.

methods.name: withType
methods.description: Sets the type concept of the MedicationDispense.

methods.name: withEncounter
methods.description: Associates an Encounter with the MedicationDispense using an encounter ID, also sets location and dispenser based on the encounter.

methods.name: withLocation
methods.description: Sets the location where the medication was dispensed.

methods.name: withDispenser
methods.description: Sets the provider responsible for dispensing the medication.

methods.name: withDrugOrder
methods.description: Associates a DrugOrder with the MedicationDispense and copies relevant details.

methods.name: withDrug
methods.description: Sets the drug and substitution details.

methods.name: withDatePrepared
methods.description: Sets the date when the medication was prepared.

methods.name: withDateHandedOver
methods.description: Sets the date when the medication was handed over.

methods.name: withFormNamespaceAndPath
methods.description: Sets the form namespace and path.
